title: Great experience with Kids
text: Awesome experience! I went with my son and it was great to see how interested and engaged he was throughout the tour. The way the history of the Gothic Quarter was explained made it fun and easy for him to connect with the place. A great experience for kids and parents alike. Highly recommended!
author: E4301QMvictore

title: Recommended!!
text:
The tour was very entertaining, perfect if you are with children! The kids were super entertained with the map and the clues, so we walked through the Gothic Quarter without them getting bored even once, which allowed us to enjoy the walk more calmly. Also, it was very interesting to learn things about Barcelona in such a relaxed and educational way.

We really liked the experience; it is clear that it is well thought out for families. The guide was very nice, friendly, and knowledgeable. I totally recommend it if you are coming as a family!
author: 55fernandae

title: A fun way to discover Barcelona
text: A very entertaining and educational experience for the children. The guide makes the tour through the center of Barcelona in a very playful and dynamic way, giving each one a map so they can put a sticker on the places they are visiting. It is a fun way to get to know the city and keep the children's attention. Highly recommended for families!
author: javierav229

title: Entertaining!
text: We loved the experience! The guide was very kind and knowledgeable about many facts that are usually overlooked in typical internet guides. The tour made the girls feel motivated to keep moving forward and discovering interesting details about the city. We had a very good time.
author: 108trinic

title: Maria was excellent and...
text: Maria was excellent and knew exactly what to say and do for everyone’s enjoyment. The children really enjoyed her.
author: Jeanne_A

title: Entertaining and educational experience for adults and children
text:
We took the tour with my wife and three of my grandchildren, 6, 9, and 12 years old. They remained interested throughout the entire trip.
We all learned; I highlight the guide, who was very educational, entertaining, and willing to answer all the children's questions.
author: IsabelAmenabar

title: Would definitely recommend
text: Maria was a wonderful and knowledgeable guide. She adapted to the kids, yet provided thorough details and history of the city.
author: janebA1694JW

title: Fascinating
text: We wanted to tour to get to know the center of Barcelona, but we feared that the children would get tired or bored, it was entertaining for everyone. The guide entertaining and enjoyable. Children had a lot of fun (children 6 and 9)
author: IsabelAmenabar

title: Magic Family Tour ✨
text:
We did the Family tour, which I recommend 100%, with our children 6 and 8, it was a very good experience for the whole family. From the beginning, the guide captured the attention of children with stories and characters to discover. 
Our children felt like little scouts following clues on the map, looking for guardians hiding in the squares and streets. 
The tour lasts about 2 hrs, walk around emblematic places and the pace was ideal for them.
author: isabelpP5976HD

title: 💯 recommended 👌🥇
text:
Very good experience to know Barcelona in a different way, learn from its secrets, culture and the best thing is that it is in Familia! 
The guide, the Mané has a lot of experience and knows how to charm children, always very attentive and motivated! 

100% recommended
